Introduction

Henry, also known as Henry Lau, is a Chinese-Canadian singer-songwriter, multi-instrumentalist, composer, and actor. He first gained recognition as a member of SUPER JUNIOR’s sub-unit SUPER JUNIOR-M in 2008 before making his solo debut on June 7, 2013 with the mini album Trap. His career spans music, film, television, and the arts, establishing him as one of the most versatile entertainers in the Korean and Chinese entertainment industries. In April 2018, Henry parted ways with SM Entertainment and Label SJ following the expiration of his contract. He soon established his own one-man agency in China and later signed with Monster Entertainment Group and AXIS to manage his global activities. Since then, Henry has continued to expand his career internationally. His 2017 OST It’s You became the most streamed Korean soundtrack on Spotify for two consecutive years, further cementing his reputation as a successful solo artist.

Beyond music, Henry made his Hollywood debut in 2019 with A Dog’s Journey and starred in the 2020 action-fantasy film Double World, which marked a milestone as the first Chinese-produced movie to receive a simultaneous global release through Netflix and iQIYI. On television, his variety show appearances on Real Man and I Live Alone earned him major recognition, including the Best Newcomer Award in 2014 and the Excellence Male Award in 2017 at the MBC Entertainment Awards. Henry is also an entrepreneur and artist. In 2018, he opened the Taiwanese restaurant Xiao Zhan in Seoul, later expanding with a second branch. His artwork was showcased in 2021 at the START Art Fair at London’s Saatchi Gallery in a special exhibit highlighting K-pop’s cultural influence. Alongside his creative pursuits, Henry has been actively engaged in philanthropy, serving as a goodwill ambassador for organizations such as Save the Children and the International Vaccine Institute. He has also supported music education programs and campaigns promoting youth welfare and social causes.
